title: Canada is unaffected: a Canadian company gets 404 on every GST route and gains no GST codes or accounts
GST codes come only from an approved rule: a draft rule and an Editor are refused; the approved 18% rule makes GST18 (CGST 9 + SGST 9) and IGST18 with their GL accounts; repeating changes nothing
Intra-state sale (customer in Maharashtra): CGST 9% + SGST 9% credited to 2401 and 2402; place of supply 27 saved; an IGST code is refused

Inter-state sale (customer in Karnataka): IGST 18% to 2404, place of supply 29; the CGST/SGST code is refused; an explicit place of supply in Maharashtra makes it intra-state; an export is inter-state (96)
A line with no tax code takes the item's GST rate rule (India Masters) for the supply type; an explicit "no tax" stays without GST

The rule in force on the document date decides: after a later approved version changes the rate, the old code is refused for that date (and still accepted before it); codes made from the new version work
Purchases: a supplier in Maharashtra is intra-state (input CGST/SGST to 1451/1452); a supplier registered in Gujarat is inter-state (input IGST to 1454); the wrong supply type is refused
Only GST codes in an India company: a plain tax code is refused on an invoice; a bank line or expense cannot take a GST code (no place of supply there)
